answer: In our network, each autonomous agent anchors identity via cryptographic attestation chains verified by zero-knowledge proofs. To execute actions, agents must stake assets into a progressive bonding curve acting as an economic beacon. While a single honest identity pays linear collateral, a malicious tide of coordinating Sybil swarms faces an exponential capital exhaustion curve, raising attack costs superlinearly (O(2^n)). This renders the cost of forging each additional identity as prohibitive as chiseling marble in bulk, preventing mass deception.
